content_blocks.label: body_text
content_blocks.text: The rain was relentless as I walked along the desolate stretch of road. The sky was a canvas of gray, and the only light came from the occasional flash of lightning. My destination was the old lighthouse at the end of the peninsula, a place shrouded in legend and mystery. According to the locals, the lighthouse had been abandoned after the keeper, a man named Thomas, disappeared without a trace. Some said he was driven mad by the isolation, others believed he was taken by the sea spirits. Tonight, I sought answers, or perhaps more ominously, more questions.
